title: Practical Cosmetics
description: This mod aims to add cosmetics that not only look great but actually get usage over vanilla armor too! Also has a ton of references.
body:
# DESCRIPTION
### A mod full of silly cosmetic items, most of which are references to other games. I aim to add around 30 different cosmetics, all with their own custom abilities or uses. All cosmetic items can be obtained in survival mode.

## ITEMS

### RELEASE
- **Chieftain Mask**
- **Eye of Providence Mask**
- **Shield of Virtues**
- **Majora's Mask**
- **Corvo's Mask**
- **Reality Scar**

### UPDATE 1
- **The Red Crown**
- **The Green Crown**
- **The Yellow Crown**
- **The Blue Crown**
- **The Purple Crown**
- **The Cyan Crown**
- **Sunhat**
- **Sunglasses**

### Pride! (All of which are retextures of the Reality Scar)
- **Lesbian Tear**
- **Gay Tear**
- **Bisexual Tear**
- **Transgender Tear**
- **Pride Tear**
- **Non-Binary Tear**

## OBTAINMENT METHODS

### Most items have recipes that unlock automatically when their required materials are gathered, though im listing the items required for each recipe here.

### CRAFTING (Release)

- **Cheiftain Mask** : 5x Bone, 1x Bone Block, 1x Red Dye, 1x Wheat

- **Majora's Mask** : 3x Any Log, 2x Blaze Rod, 1x Soulsand

- **Reality Scar** : 2x Black Concrete, 1x Ghast Tear

- **Shield of Virtues** : 1x End Crystal, 6x Phantom Membrane, 1x Gold Ingot

- **Corvo's Mask** : 1x Leather Helmet, 1x Netherite Ingot, 2x Iron Ingot, 4x Eye of Ender, 1x Glass

### CRAFTING (Update 1)

- **Sunhat** : 3x Wheat, 1x Any Flower

- **Sunglasses** : 2x Any Wood Slab, 1x Tinted Glass

### OTHER (Release)

- **Eye of Providence Mask** : Obtained from rare structures called "Providence Shrines". Can be found in all biomes on solid ground.

### OTHER (Update 1)

- **The Red Crown** : Obtained randomly when dying. When in Hardcore, can be obtained when randomly killing entities.

- **The Green Crown** : Obtained randomly by killing entities.

- **The Yellow Crown** : Obtained randomly when bonemealing crops.

- **The Blue Crown** : Obtained randomly when taking Withering damage

- **The Purple Crown** : Obtained randomly when taking damage from enchanted weapons.

- **The Cyan Crown** : Obtained randomly when taking Fire or Ice damage.

### PRIDE

All of the Pride items are crafted with 3 colored concrete based on their coloration.

- **Lesbian Flag** : Orange, White, Magenta

- **Gay Flag** : Cyan, White, Light Blue

- **Bi Flag** : Blue, Purple, Magenta

- **Trans Flag** : Light Blue, Pink, White

- **Pride Flag** : Red, Yellow, Blue

- **Enby Flag** : Yellow, White, Purple

## REFERENCES (Release)
- The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
- Rain World
- ULTRAKILL
- Dishonored 2

## REFERENCES (Update 1)
- Cult of the Lamb
